subject: Request: temporary P2 latency tolerance during nightly batch window
messages:
From: Helen Zhou <hzhou@nimbuspay.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@techprocure.com
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Nightly batch - request for temporary P2 tolerance

Hi Alex,

We start the final stage of our merchant ingestion rollout next week. To reconcile ledger entries we run a heavy nightly batch between 01:00-03:30 UTC that will temporarily increase error surface and support noise for a few days. Our SREs estimate bursts of incidents that will fall into your P2 bucket (retries, partial failures, degraded latency) rather than P3.

Given the launch timing, can Redwood accept a temporary P2 response "tolerance" for the batch window on Sep 20-24 (4 nights) with a defined rollback and monitoring checklist so our procurement team can sign off? Our asks:
- A documented carveout window where P2 response SLA (15m) will not trigger credits if occurrences are related to the nightly reconciliation job.
- A short mutual action plan (dates, owners, monitoring thresholds, rollback steps).
- Confirmation of on-call coverage and an escalation contact list during the window.

Attaching the maintenance schedule and high-level runbook. Procurement copied for contract amendments.

Thanks,
Helen
Head of Integrations, NimbusPay
attachments: nimbus-nightly-maintenance-plan.pdf

From: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Helen Zhou <hzhou@nimbuspay.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, procurement@techprocure.com
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Nightly batch - request for temporary P2 tolerance

Hi Helen — thanks for the heads up and the plan. I reviewed the attachment briefly and this seems scope-limited (ingestion reconciliation only). A few clarifying Qs before I loop in Ops & Risk for sign-off:

1) Can you confirm the exact UTC window per night (start/end) and whether the job will run on retry/backoff if it fails?
2) Expected increase in P2s: rough magnitude (e.g., 10-50 incidents/night) and whether they affect authentication or only ingestion/error processing.
3) Do you require us to mute monitoring alerts to downstream tooling or just exclude incidents from SLA credit calculations?

Proposed next steps on our side:
- I'll draft a short mutual action plan (MAP) that includes sequence, primary/secondary owners from Redwood, and rollback triggers.
- Loop in Karthik (SRE lead) for fallback routing and on-call roster for the window.
- Marissa (ops manager) to approve any credit exclusions and confirm acceptance criteria.

If all good, we can publish a limited carveout addendum for 20–24 Sep with explicit monitoring thresholds (e.g., token failure rate > 3% sustained for 10m triggers rollback). I'll attach a draft MAP once I have your answers.

Best,
Alex
Customer Success, Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>, Helen Zhou <hzhou@nimbuspay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, procurement@techprocure.com
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Nightly batch - request for temporary P2 tolerance

Thanks for looping me in. Answering Alex's Qs and adding Ops details:

1) Confirmed window: 01:00-03:30 UTC nightly (Sep 20, 21, 22, 23). If job retries push beyond 03:30 we need an explicit message from Nimbus SREs to extend the carveout.
2) Estimated noise: based on your note, plan for up to ~40 P2-class incidents/night impacting ingestion queues only. We will not treat auth or data-leak issues under this tolerance — those still require immediate P1 response.
3) We will not mute Prometheus/alerting generically. Instead we will:
   - Add an alert annotation "nimbus-nightly" and keep alerts firing for visibility.
   - Exclude qualifying incidents (annotated and tagged as "ingestion-reconciliation") from SLA credit calculus for the listed window only.

On-call coverage & escalation:
- Primary on-call: Karthik Iyer (SRE), follow-up: Marie Chen (SRE-2), escalation to Marissa Cole (Ops Manager).
- Email escalation list: ops-escalations@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai.

Attached: fallback routing workbook (redwood-fallback-routing.xlsx) with two quick mitigations we can activate (queue-throttling + prefix-KV-caching freeze).

I'll mark the MAP draft: include rollback triggers (token failure > 3% for 10m OR error-rate spike > 5% for 5m), required notification cadence, and a post-window incident report within 48h.

-Karthik
SRE Lead, Redwood Inference
attachments: redwood-fallback-routing.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Helen Zhou <hzhou@nimbuspay.com>
Cc: procurement@techprocure.com
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Nightly batch - request for temporary P2 tolerance

Helen / Alex — thanks, this looks well-scoped. Formal sign-off from Redwood with these conditions: 

1) Window limited to 20–23 Sep (4 nights inclusive, 01:00-03:30 UTC). Any extension requires a new written request at least 48h before the planned extension.
2) Incidents touching authentication, encryption keys, or data exfiltration are excluded from the carveout and will be treated as P1.
3) Rollback triggers are as Karthik outlined. Activation of rollback must be communicated within 10 minutes to ops-escalations@redwood.ai.
4) Nimbus must provide a post-window report within 48h summarizing root causes and mitigation steps. Failure to provide the report will void carveout for future requests.
5) No SLA credits will apply for qualifying P2 incidents during the window; other SLA terms remain unchanged.

Once Nimbus confirms the window and agrees to the post-window report requirement we will publish a short carveout addendum (to be appended to the existing agreement) and ensure our billing/SLAs systems exclude the annotated incidents from credit calculations for those nights.

Helen — can you confirm acceptance (I can prepare a one-paragraph addendum and share on DocuSign via procurement)?

Marissa
Director, Customer Operations — Redwood Inference

On Fri, Sep 18, 2026 at 16:05, Helen Zhou <hzhou@nimbuspay.com> wrote:
> Thanks Marissa — we accept the conditions. DocuSign would be great. I will ask SRE to push the notification to you if we need to extend.
